auto.introBefore: On the date, time and place stated above, I, F
auto.introAfter: , in the presence of the other participants listed above, began the inspection provided for in Article 12 of Decree-Law No. 89/2023 of 20 December, required for the issuance of the licence to carry out the commercial activity.
auto.scope: The inspection covered the technical and sanitary conditions of commercial establishments, in accordance with Annex IV of the aforementioned decree, namely:
auto.section2: 2. The chosen land, taking into account the following facilities:
auto.sanitarias: Shared sanitary facilities with running water
auto.descreverIrregularidades: It was found that (describe the irregularities and/or omissions):
auto.deliberacao: Having deliberated, the Inspection Team considers the commercial establishment:
auto.aptoAberto: Fit to open to the public
auto.comDeficiencias: With deficiencies, and recommended that they be remedied
auto.recomendacoes: In view of the irregularities and omissions detected, and with a view to remedying them, the following recommendations were issued:
auto.prazoBefore: Considering the complexity of the deficiencies to be remedied, a period of
auto.prazoAfter: days is granted for the applicant, if so wishing, to regularise them.
auto.naoObservacao: Failure to follow the recommendations made will consequently result in the rejection of the request in the process.
auto.notificacao: The applicant was hereby notified that, if the period granted expires without the deficiencies and/or omissions being corrected or remedied, the licensing request will be rejected, with no right to any refund of fees or forms paid.

fields.legislacaoUrbanistica: The choice of site must meet the requirements of urban-planning legislation, taking particular account of existing urban plans or the guidance given by the competent local authorities
fields.escoamentoAguas: Wastewater drainage, which must comply with the public sanitation regulations adopted or to be adopted
fields.alimentacaoEnergia: Installation of a medium-voltage (high-voltage) electricity supply line
fields.sanitasAutomaticaAgua: Equipped with toilets with automatic water flushing:
fields.comunicacaoVentilacao: Direct opening to the outside, or be fitted with artificial ventilation devices providing continuous air renewal suited to their size:
fields.esgotoAguas: Connected to an internal sewage network that carries wastewater to systems suitable for its disposal, namely the public network or, where none exists, a collection and treatment system suited to the volume and nature of that water:
fields.paredesPavimentos: The walls, floors and ceilings of the sanitary facilities must be covered with durable, waterproof, non-flammable, easy-to-clean materials:
fields.zonasDestinadas: Must not be located next to areas used to prepare and cook food or to eat meals:
fields.instalacoesFrigorificas: Cold-storage facilities for refrigeration and preservation, where applicable:
fields.sectoresLimpos: Separation of clean and dirty areas:
fields.pisosParedes: Floors and walls - buildings must be fitted with devices protecting against insects and rodents, and designed to allow easy application of hygiene standards; to that end:
fields.pisosResistentes: Floors must be durable, fully watertight, non-slip, with a slope of around 3% and a suitable drainage network for liquids:
fields.paredesInteriores: Interior walls and the floor must have a washable covering:
fields.paredes3metros: Up to a height of 3 metres, walls must have an impact-resistant, waterproof, smooth and rot-proof covering:
fields.unioesParedes: Joints between walls and the ceilings and floors must be rounded:
fields.ventilacoesNecessarias: Adequate ventilation must be ensured in all areas:
fields.iluminacao: Lighting, natural or artificial, must be suited to the characteristics of each area:
fields.aguaPotavel: The establishment must have a pressurised drinking-water network, cold and/or hot, in sufficient quantity to meet its needs:
fields.distribuicaoAgua: The water distribution network must have the necessary number of water outlets to ensure cleaning and washing in all its activities, including staff hygiene:
fields.redeDistribuicao: There may be a properly signposted non-drinking-water distribution network for steam generators, commercial refrigeration installations, fire hydrants, gardening and other auxiliary services, provided there is no connection between it and the drinking-water network:
fields.redeEsgotos: The sewage network, cesspits or septic tanks must allow easy inspection, cleaning and disinfection, and have trap valves, protective grilles and grease traps:
fields.equipamentoUtensilios: All equipment and utensils must be made of durable material that is easy to clean and disinfect:
fields.recipientesLixo: Have lidded rubbish bins placed in easily accessible, clearly signposted locations:
fields.limpezaDiaria: Daily cleaning and disinfection of the containers is mandatory, and rubbish and other waste must be removed daily to a suitable place to be collected by the public waste-collection services:
fields.maximoHigieneSeguranca: Ensure maximum hygiene and safety for workers:
